name: singlet_communication_lr_interaction_scoring
title: Sender-receiver ligand-receptor interaction scoring
description: Scores ligand-receptor pairs for every ordered pair of annotated cell groups from a normalised expression layer, with label-permutation p-values and FDR. The default method is cellphonedb (mean score); other methods are published alternatives selected by method. Use it for steady-state communication between groups; do not use it to compare conditions (use the differential communication task) or for spatial neighbourhoods.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

groupby.description: obs column holding the sender and receiver group labels, for example cell_type or leiden.

method.description: Scoring method; cellphonedb is the default mean-score standard, the others are published alternatives.

resource.description: Ligand-receptor resource: a name in uns or a built-in name; consensus is the LIANA default.

filters.description: Group and expression filters for the LIANA-implemented methods.

min_cells.description: Minimum cells per group; smaller groups are dropped.

expr_prop.description: Minimum fraction of a group's cells expressing a partner for the tuple to be scored.

n_perms.description: Label permutations for cellphonedb and squidpy_ligrec; cellchat uses cellchat.nboot.

seed.description: Random seed for label permutations; fixes the null draws.

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without executing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

cellchat.description: CellChat options, used only when method is cellchat.

nboot.description: Label permutations for the CellChat null.

trim.description: Trim fraction, used only by truncatedMean and thresholdedMean; ignored for triMean.

Kh.description: Hill half-saturation constant applied to the product.

squidpy_ligrec.description: squidpy ligrec options, used only when method is squidpy_ligrec.

threshold.description: Minimum fraction of cells expressing each partner in a cluster for the pair to be tested.

complex_policy.description: How complex subunits are combined, following squidpy's policy.

corr_method.description: Multiple-testing correction name; null returns raw permutation p-values.

alpha.description: Significance level for the significant flag.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: finished inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: continues as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written, e.g. uns/lr_interactions. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed calls: method, n_tuples_tested, n_fdr_below_alpha and the top 20 interactions. Never raw matrices.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
